source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Service Sheet (Part 2225623, 120 V)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Access module test points
steps.body: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall.

steps.title: Restore power for live check
steps.body: Reconnect power. Use meter or test light at module L–N test points.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect power. Use meter or test light at module L–N test points.

steps.title: L–N line voltage present?
steps.body: At L–N: line voltage = power OK; 0 V = no power to module.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At L–N: line voltage = power OK; 0 V = no power to module.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: No line voltage at module — trace harness, shut-off arm, and cabinet supply.

steps.title: No module power
steps.oemOutcome: Repair harness or supply path to ice maker module.

steps.title: Module power OK
steps.oemOutcome: L–N line voltage verified at module.
